scripts.build: npm run generate && npm run typecheck && vite build
scripts.test: npm run generate && npm run check:modules && node tools/check.cjs && node tools/hardening-check.cjs && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:engine: npm run generate && node --test tests/modular-engine.test.mjs tests/workflows.test.mjs tests/assessment-guidance.test.mjs tests/brightspace-definition-coverage.test.mjs tests/field-evidence.test.mjs
scripts.test:extractors: npm run generate && node --test tests/extractor-runtime.test.mjs tests/assignment-identity.test.mjs tests/corpus-extraction.test.mjs tests/retry-evidence.test.mjs
scripts.test:navigation: npm run generate && node --test tests/owner-actions.test.mjs tests/source-plugin-followup.test.mjs
scripts.worker:check: npm run generate && npx --yes wrangler@4.143.0 deploy --dry-run --config workers/coursera-extractor/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.worker:deploy: npm run generate && npx --yes wrangler@4.143.0 deploy --config workers/coursera-extractor/wrangler.jsonc
